title: Blues dancing: Basic up and down pulse for beginners

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor patiently explains foundational concepts using descriptive metaphors and physical demonstrations. He breaks down movements systematically from basic pulses to side-to-side steps.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces the topic of basic blues pulse for beginners.
Demonstrates up and down pulses briefly.
Explains knee bending mechanism and posture.
Integrates pulse with side-to-side weight transfer.
Counts out 16 beats of down pulse practice.

cues: Put all your weight on your right leg
metaphors: Tapping a drum with your knees in front of you
Imagining a drum behind your knees
common_mistakes: Doing the drum hit too hard and hurting your knees
safety: Don't do this too hard because then you'll hurt your knees

steps_taught.name: Down pulse
steps_taught.description: Bending knees forward on the beat.

steps_taught.name: Side to side basic step
steps_taught.description: Stepping side to side while pulsing.

what_works: Clear visual imagery like hitting a drum
Breaking down movements step by step from stationary to moving
what_hinders: Pacing can be a bit repetitive during long counts

quotes.text: The difference is where we put the accent on the rhythm.
Don't do this too hard because then you'll hurt your knees.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates knee bending sideways to camera from profile angle.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using the imagery of hitting a virtual drum with the front and back of the knees to teach pulsing dynamics.
